title: Feedback from every site, and the hub as the way in
audience: Dinis: what sherpa.d has done, and three decisions for him
summary: sherpa.d mapped four kinds of user and read the hub page cold. The hub page has no door for feedback. D2 is provisionally yes from helm.d and maestro.d; D3 is Dinis's, because deleted audio cannot be brought back. Nothing is tested with a real user yet.

beats.narration: You want to give feedback from every site, by voice or text, to the agents working on it. sherpa.d has mapped what exists and what is missing.
Four kinds of user need four doors into the same lane: you, another agent, a customer, and a party we wrote to.

items: Dinis: signs, and wants to know who heard
Another agent: verifies, and must not be blocked in silence
A party we reached out to: replies to a named thread, no private contact

beats.narration: Some parts exist, separately and not connected: sign-in by QR, sealed agent lanes, anonymous page signals, one registry of sites, and voice and text inside the Decision Desk. Each is still to be re-checked by its owner.

items: PKI sign-in by QR or link
Voice and text, only inside the Decision Desk (a claude.ai page, not a site)

beats.narration: Five dots are missing: which agents work on each site, one control on every site, voice to text, the answer back, and doors for the other three users.

items: Which agents work on each site
One 'Tell the team' control in the sites bar
Voice to text on the way in
The answer back to the person
The same shape for the other users

beats.narration: Read cold at 13:50 UTC, the hub page has no feedback control anywhere. That is the first of five findings, H1 to H5.

visual.label: feedback controls on the hub page (hub.sovereignweb.site, read 22 November, 13:50 UTC; the sites themselves not read)

beats.narration: The other four: no sign of what changed or what needs you, no search, no agent shown per site, and no promised way back to the hub.

items: H2 No 'what changed, what needs me'
H4 No agent shown per site
H5 No promised way back to the hub

beats.narration: One caution: all of this is read from the record and the pages. Nothing has been tested with a real user yet.

visual.text: Not yet tested with a real user

decisions.question: D2: where does a site's feedback land first?

options.label: The site's lead agent, who routes it

decisions.why: No agent is asked to guess; needs each site's lead in the registry. helm.d and maestro.d have said yes provisionally.

decisions.question: D3 (Dinis decides): voice memos, what happens to the audio?

options.label: Transcript only, audio dropped at once
bad: A wrong transcript cannot be checked against audio

options.label: Transcript kept; audio kept 7 days in a private vault, then deleted
good: A wrong transcript can be checked within a week
bad: A private vault to keep and a deletion to run

options.label: Transcript and audio both kept
bad: Needs a vault, a retention rule and counsel.d's view
blocks: The memo feature until a vault exists

decisions.why: sherpa.d's file recommends transcript only; helm.d's decision page recommends option b (7 days) because a mis-heard word could then be checked. The page holds both views. Source s2.
